name: charterion
description: Open-source multi-agent engineering control plane for ChatGPT Web Agents.

scripts.check: npm run check:native-rpc-contract && npm run check:version-metadata && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:faults: vitest run tests/faultMatrix.test.ts tests/recovery.test.ts tests/contentRuntimeFence.test.ts tests/tabOperationQueue.test.ts tests/coalescingRunner.test.ts control/tests/controlPlane.test.ts --pool=forks --fileParallelism=false
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:control && npm run check:assets && npm run check:readme-i18n && npm run check:deployment-docs && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:workflow-pinning && npm run test && npm run test:faults && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run build:control
scripts.release: npm run sync:version-metadata && npm run verify:full && npm run check:readme-i18n:release && node scripts/package-release.mjs && node scripts/package-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:native: npm run generate:native-rpc-contract && dotnet build native-host/GamNativeHost/GamNativeHost.csproj -c Release
scripts.smoke:native: npm run build:control && npm run publish:native && node scripts/smoke-native-host.mjs
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run publish:native && node scripts/smoke-control.mjs && node scripts/smoke-evidence.mjs && node scripts/smoke-self-hosting.mjs && node scripts/smoke-change-request.mjs && node scripts/smoke-fleet.mjs && node scripts/smoke-native-host.mjs && npm run smoke:runtime-install && node scripts/smoke-launcher.mjs
